balanceReasonTypeHint.INITIAL_STOCKTAKE: Baseline count when the ledger is first created.
balanceReasonTypeHint.STOCKTAKE_CORRECTION: Correction after a stocktake finds a mismatch.
balanceReasonTypeHint.DAMAGE_SCRAP: Containers scrapped and removed from available stock.
balanceReasonTypeHint.HISTORICAL_BACKFILL: Backfill for missed historical ledger changes.
balanceReasonTypeHint.TRANSFER_SETTLEMENT: Auto-posted when a transfer is confirmed; not selectable manually.
balanceReasonTypeHint.TRANSFER_VOID: Auto-reversed when a confirmed transfer is voided; not selectable manually.
balanceReasonTypeHint.TRANSIT_LOSS: Gap between the quantity sent and the quantity received; auto-posted on settlement, not selectable manually.

ledger.title: Container ledger
ledger.subtitle: Maintain container stock by station × type. Manual adjustments and confirmed transfers all leave an audit trail.
ledger.negativeTooltip: This station returned more than recorded loans — missing loan records; backfill or stocktake.
ledger.noEditPermission: No permission to edit ledger quantity
ledger.noDeletePermission: No permission to delete ledger rows
ledger.emptyBalances: No ledger rows yet. Create stations under Station accounts first.
ledger.deleteStockWarning: This row still has {{quantity}} in stock; deleting removes it from the ledger.
ledger.auditIntro: Every stock change — manual or from confirmed transfers. Click linked transfer to trace source.

accounts.title: Station accounts
accounts.subtitle: Maintain responsible stations and bound users. All loans and returns are booked between station accounts.
accounts.footerEditHint: Bound users are replaced in full on save.
accounts.footerCreateHint: Users and alerts are created with the station; any failure rolls back the whole create.
accounts.noSystemAccount: This party has no system login
accounts.boundUsersLabel: Users who can act for this station
accounts.boundUsersHintSelected: {{count}} selected. They see this station's ledger and transfers and can initiate or confirm as this station.
accounts.boundUsersHintEmpty: Without bindings, only super admins see this station.
accounts.pushHintDisabled: Alerts off — no push for this station's transfers.
accounts.pushHintActive: DM {{count}} people on new transfer, dispute, confirm, or settlement accept. Edits/deletes do not push.
accounts.pushHintNoRecipients: No recipients selected — nothing will push even when enabled.
accounts.confirmDeleteContent: Rejected if this station has ledger rows or transfers.

transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.subtitle: Each container move is one transfer. Loans and returns update stock only after receiver confirmation; mismatches enter dispute.
transfers.noAccountHint: You are not bound to any station — contact an admin to bind you under Station accounts
transfers.footerEditHint: Pending receiver rows: date and lines only; kind and parties are fixed.
transfers.footerCreateHint: {{count}} group(s), one batch; any invalid group fails the whole batch.
transfers.errSameAccount: From and to cannot be the same
transfers.errMinOneLine: Enter quantity for at least one type
transfers.errQuantityInt: Quantity must be a positive integer
transfers.confirmFooterNormal: If quantities differ, use Report discrepancy.
transfers.confirmFooterProxy: Books declared quantities in full; cannot undo.
transfers.noteProxyPlaceholder: e.g. broker WeChat receipt, quantities verified
transfers.disputeWarning: Enters dispute; stock unchanged until sender accepts your received quantities.
transfers.receivedQtyHint: Fixed to sender's lines; 0–declared each; all 0 means nothing received.
transfers.disputeReasonPlaceholder: e.g. 3 big blue containers short after count
transfers.errAllReceivedQty: Enter received qty for every type
transfers.errReceivedRange: Received qty must be an integer 0–{{max}}
transfers.deleteHint: Snapshot and reason kept; find it under Change log.
transfers.voidHint: Row stays as Voided with reversal entries in ledger and Change log.
transfers.voidBalanceHint: If receiver already re-loaned these containers, reversal may go negative — a signal to stocktake offline, not a bug.
transfers.changeIntro: Edits, deletes, and voids. Deleted rows keep a full snapshot; voided rows stay with reversal flows.
transfers.sectionUpdateReportDesc: Cannot exceed declared; sender sees your latest received qty
transfers.onlyPartiesCanAct: Only sender and receiver can act
transfers.acceptConfirmZero: Settle at 0 received? Transfer will cancel; no stock change.
transfers.acceptConfirmDetail: Settle at received lines ({{details}}, {{total}} pcs)? Books immediately.
transfers.importFooterDefault: One transaction: any invalid row blocks the batch.
transfers.importFooterErrors: {{count}} row(s) need fixes — re-upload after editing.
transfers.importFooterReady: {{count}} row(s) passed — writes in one batch and sends summary alerts to both parties.
transfers.importDownloadHint: Use dropdowns for type, from, and to — typed station names must match exactly.
transfers.importDropTitle: Drop file here or click to browse
transfers.proxyEvidenceRequired: Proxy confirmation signs on the other party’s behalf, so a receipt or signed slip is required

reconciliation.footnote: Expand a counterparty for sent − received = net; numbers link to confirmed transfers. Transfers only — no stocktake/scrap; in-transit excluded.
reconciliation.emptyNoAccounts: No stations to reconcile — create stations first.
reconciliation.emptyNoHistory: No container activity with this station yet.
reconciliation.loadFailed: Reconciliation failed to load — try again.

importTemplate.creator: Container management
importTemplate.guideLine1: Fill data only on "{{dataSheet}}"; do not edit "{{refSheet}}" or this sheet.
importTemplate.guideLine2: One row = one transfer. Put big blue and silver container qty on the same row when both apply.
importTemplate.guideLine3: Enter at least one qty column; blank means that type is not on this transfer; qty must be a positive integer.
importTemplate.guideLine4: Use the dropdown for business type.
importTemplate.guideLine5: From/to: use dropdown, copy names from "{{refSheet}}", or type exactly (spaces/case ignored).
importTemplate.guideLine6: From must be your bound stations (ref sheet col A); to can be any station (col B).
importTemplate.guideLine7: Unknown station names are flagged in preview — fix and re-upload.
importTemplate.guideLine8: Date YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-08-27; blank defaults to today.
importTemplate.guideLine9: Note optional (plate, waybill, etc.), max 2000 chars.
importTemplate.guideLine10: Max {{max}} rows per upload; one transaction — any invalid row fails all.
importTemplate.guideLine11: Batch import does not send Feishu alerts — notify receivers separately.
importTemplate.guideExampleRow1: 2026-08-27 | Loan | Hub A | Broker B | 120 | 30 | Plate ABC123

importParse.errFromNotMine: From "{{name}}" is not your bound station — use col A on "{{refSheet}}"
importParse.errSameAccount: From and to cannot be the same
importParse.errMinOneType: Enter quantity for at least one type
importParse.errEmptyUseTemplate: Empty sheet — use the downloaded template

importParse.errTooManyRows: Max {{max}} rows; file has {{count}} — split and retry
importParse.errParseFailed: Parse failed — check file is valid Excel/CSV

timeline.proxyConfirmDesc: {{to}} has no login;{{actor}}confirmed from offline receipt at declared quantities.
timeline.partialConfirmDesc: Received total differed from declared; booked at received.
timeline.bookedDesc: Stock adjusted by type as below.
timeline.voidedDesc: Voided by{{actor}}; booking below reversed on both ledgers.
timeline.pendingDisputedDesc: Receiver may update received qty; sender may accept.
timeline.pendingReceiverDesc: Waiting for confirm or discrepancy report.

toast.transferVoided: Voided; booking reversed on both ledgers
toast.deepLinkNotFound: Transfer not found — deleted or no access
toast.deepLinkNotReceiver: Only receiver can confirm — opening timeline
toast.deepLinkNotDisputed: No longer in dispute — opening timeline

types.hint: A new type can be used in transfers, ledgers and reconciliation right away. Types with existing records can only be deactivated, not deleted — deactivating just removes them from the pickers for new records; history still displays and settles as before.
types.deleteBlocked: This type already has transfer or ledger records and cannot be deleted; use the toggle to deactivate it instead
types.disabled: Container type deactivated; historical records are unaffected
types.lastActiveBlocked: At least one active type must remain, otherwise new transfers and ledger rows have nothing to pick
